title: Stabilize Desktop Overlay Runtime
summary: Stabilize the current main worktree by separating Maestro documentation from runtime code, validating Live Caption collapsed/debug behavior, checking app runtime helper seams, preserving overlay interaction contracts, and preparing safe worktree cleanup/harvest without destructive actions.
approach: Proceed in dependency order: first protect context and classify the dirty main worktree, then validate the highest-risk Live Caption/debug runtime changes, then validate app runtime helper seams and overlay integration, then produce a non-destructive cleanup/harvest inventory for old worktrees. Do not merge or delete worktrees in this plan.

waves.label: Protect context and split main worktree
waves.rationale: The dirty main worktree must be classified before runtime validation or cleanup decisions.

waves.label: Validate runtime code slices
waves.rationale: Live Caption/debug runtime has the highest risk and should be checked before broader runtime and overlay assertions.

waves.label: Prepare non-destructive worktree cleanup path
waves.rationale: Old worktree pruning and branch cleanup require a harvest inventory after current main is understood.
